title: Bloor Street West Bike Lane Pilot Project Evaluation
method: Before June 2016, early after October 2016, and season-matched June 2017 counts and vehicle travel times; measured parallel Dupont and Harbord streets to assess diversion.
finding: Cycling within the pilot increased 56%. After signal adjustments, car trips were 2:00 longer eastbound in the morning peak and 4:15 longer westbound in the evening peak.
lesson: Measure the treated corridor and alternatives together; retain travel-time costs alongside bicycle growth.
limit: An observational pilot, with signal and turn changes. Parallel streets can receive diversion. No complete all-mode person-time balance.
source_pages: Design p5; cycling p7; vehicles p10; travel time p11 (printed page numbers).

authors: Prajamitra Bhuyan, Emma J. McCoy, Haojie Li and Daniel J. Graham
title: Analysing the causal effect of London cycle superhighways on traffic congestion
method: 2007–2014 panel with 75 treated and 375 control zones; propensity weighting and outcome models adjusted for traffic, road and neighborhood characteristics.
finding: Estimated motor-traffic speed changes were statistically insignificant.
lesson: Adjust for nonrandom project placement and compare changes with credible untreated roads.
limit: Early Cycle Superhighways included painted facilities. This is not exclusively a protected-lane-for-driving-lane study and does not measure all-person journeys.

authors: Marcel Moran, Malik Salman and Takahiro Yabe
title: Heterogeneous impacts of protected bike lanes on bikeshare behavior across demographic groups in New York
method: 72 million Citi Bike trips, matched stations, before/after difference-in-differences, pre-trend inspection and shuffled-date placebo checks.
finding: Estimated 379 additional rides per adjacent station per month following protected-lane installation.
lesson: Match comparable locations and test whether changes precede the intervention.
limit: Station ridership is not crossing throughput or all-traveler time; projects are not restricted to driving-lane removals.
